name: mcp-commander-materials
description: Material selection and property lookup cartridge. Provides tools for searching engineering materials, comparing properties, and recommending substitutions based on functional requirements.

tools.name: search_materials
tools.description: Search engineering materials database by name, category, or property range

tools.name: get_material_properties
tools.description: Get detailed mechanical, thermal, and chemical properties for a specific material

tools.name: compare_materials
tools.description: Compare properties of multiple materials side by side

tools.name: recommend_substitution
tools.description: Suggest material substitutions based on functional requirements and constraints

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Check material compatibility for specific environments or processes

tools.name: get_cost_estimate
tools.description: Get relative cost estimate for a material per unit weight or volume

tools.name: lookup_supplier
tools.description: Look up potential suppliers for a given material and form
